messages:
mike-customer: hey team — when I hit the API for credits with our service key it returns 1,000 trial credits, but the project console shows 0 credits and our app is being billed. started happening this morning after onboarding a few test users. can someone check?

sara-support: thanks for the ping, mike. can you paste the response from /v1/account/credits (redact full key) and the project id/org id? also which service key are you using (project vs org-level)? :mag:

mike-customer: project id proj_9x7, org org_33a. using sk_live_proj_***. curl output below (redacted):

```
$ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_proj_***" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/account/credits
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "credits": 1000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "expires_at": "2026-04-10T00:00:00Z",
  "applied_to": "service_key",
  "service_key": "proj_9x7"
}
```

mike-customer: meanwhile the console project header shows 0 credits and billing page shows tokens being charged.

sara-support: got it — tagging eng to investigate. alex, can you look at metering/credits sync for proj_9x7? I'm creating a ticket. billing-bot: new-support-ticket #SUP-4821 created.

alex-engineering: looking. first guess: either stale cache on the console frontend or the background sync that propagates grants from ledger -> UI failed. can you confirm whether the credits were granted at org-level or project-level?

sara-support: mike said project-level (applied_to service_key).

alex-engineering: ok grabbing internal logs. can you run one quick API call showing latest usage events? need a sample event id (we expect meter entries like evt_12345).

mike-customer: sample usage event id: evt_20260317001. here's the usage record we pulled from /v1/metering/events/evt_20260317001:

```
{
  "id": "evt_20260317001",
  "project_id": "proj_9x7",
  "service_key": "proj_9x7",
  "tokens": 412,
  "charged": true,
  "billing_reference": "bill_555",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-17T09:12:22Z"
}
```

alex-engineering: thanks. i'm seeing the grant event in the ledger service (grant_778) but the console cache layer's sync job shows repeated failures around the same time. grabbing sync logs:

```
2026-03-17T09:10:03Z INFO credits-sync-worker starting sync for project proj_9x7
2026-03-17T09:10:03Z ERROR credits-sync-worker failed to acquire redis-lock: LockTimeoutError
2026-03-17T09:10:04Z ERROR credits-sync-worker aborting sync for proj_9x7 (lock expired)
2026-03-17T09:10:05Z WARN http-client retrying console-cache update for proj_9x7
```

alex-engineering: digging deeper, the worker retried a few times and never completed the write to console cache. ledger shows grant, metering shows events, but cache never updated -> UI shows 0.

sara-support: any chance this is a permissions/org mapping issue? other customers saw weird mapping after the org merge.

alex-engineering: not a mapping problem here — project ids match across services. root cause appears to be our redis lock eviction that was introduced by a rate-limiter change last week; the sync worker held a lock longer than the new TTL and then aborted, leaving the state inconsistent.

mike-customer: ok, can you fix now? our app is getting charged despite us having trial credits. can you apply credits to outstanding bills?

sara-support: we're going to run a manual resync for your project and then re-run billing reconciliation. i'll keep you posted. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-bot: scheduled job credits-resync --project proj_9x7 --requester sara-support at 2026-03-17T09:25:00Z (job id job_999)

alex-engineering: manual resync started. command executed on admin box: `./admin credits resync --org org_33a --project proj_9x7 --force` output:

```
[INFO] fetching ledger grants for proj_9x7
[INFO] found grant grant_778 (1000 credits)
[INFO] writing cache key console:proj:credits:proj_9x7 -> 1000
[INFO] enqueue billing-reconcile job for proj_9x7
[OK] resync complete for proj_9x7
```

infra-bot: billing-reconcile job queued job_1000.

billing-bot: billing-reconcile job_1000 completed: 3 invoices adjusted, 412 tokens credited back to customer ledger, net balance corrected.

mike-customer: confirmed — console now shows 1000 credits and charges have been reversed. thank you! :white_check_mark:

alex-engineering: root cause: redis lock TTL regression in credits-sync-worker introduced 2026-03-10 deploy. fix landed (increase TTL + better backoff) and we've added an alert on repeated lock failures. follow-up: we'll run a sweep to find other projects that had sync failures around same window.

sara-support: closing SUP-4821 after customer confirmation. mike, reopening if you see anything else. thanks for the quick repro steps — helped us triage faster.

mike-customer: appreciate the fast help. will monitor and report if anything else shows up.

(reactions: sara-support :thumbsup:, alex-engineering :rocket:)
